summary: This bill establishes an Office of Environmental Justice within the Department of Justice to coordinate and enforce environmental justice matters, and creates a grant program to help state, local, and tribal governments enforce environmental laws in affected communities.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes an Office of Environmental Justice within the Department of Justice and a grant program to improve the capacity of state, local, and tribal governments to enforce environmental laws. This directly strengthens the enforcement and prosecution aspects of criminal justice, particularly in environmental matters, aligning with stricter justice.
